description: Defines interfaces and classes for Power HAL wrapper, including result handling, support enums, and multiple HAL version wrappers.

classes.name: HalResult
classes.description: Template class representing the result of a Power HAL call, including success, failure, and unsupported states.

classes.name: HalWrapper
classes.description: Abstract interface for Power HAL handlers with methods for setting boost, mode, creating hint sessions, and getting preferred rate.

classes.name: EmptyHalWrapper
classes.description: Implementation of HalWrapper that ignores all API calls.

classes.name: HidlHalWrapperV1_0
classes.description: Wrapper for Power HAL version 1.0 using HIDL.

classes.name: HidlHalWrapperV1_1
classes.description: Wrapper for Power HAL version 1.1 extending V1_0.

classes.name: HidlHalWrapperV1_2
classes.description: Wrapper for Power HAL version 1.2 extending V1_1.

classes.name: HidlHalWrapperV1_3
classes.description: Wrapper for Power HAL version 1.3 extending V1_2.

classes.name: AidlHalWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper for Power HAL using AIDL interface.

methods.name: ok
methods.description: Creates a successful HalResult with a value.

methods.name: failed
methods.description: Creates a failed HalResult with an error message.

methods.name: fromStatus
methods.description: Creates HalResult from binder or hardware status.

methods.name: fromReturn
methods.description: Creates HalResult from hardware return objects.
